comments.author: @bisonic1
comments.text: Outlet testers don't accurately verify GFCI protection on older homes that are ungrounded as they short to ground rather than compare hot and neutral currents.  Without a ground, the test will fail even if the GFCI is working.  This looks like a new home though so should have a ground.
